geometry_bands.source_anchor: bow projectile that EXPLODES on impact, poisoning all nearby enemies in a small radius ('fires Projectiles that explode and Poison all nearby enemies'). One-button mapping clear. The projectile spine folds into the impact explosion; the every-3-seconds loop (7.2) is fire-arrow-into-pack -> small poison detonation -> ground_targeted_circle. poison ailment core. element earth per Section-1 chaos-poison branch: nature/venom poison-bow -> earth (PoE1 pconc venom->earth precedent), ailment lane = poison.

Toxic Growth places ground pustule clusters; Gas Arrow creates standing poison clouds and DETONATES the pustules for boss burst ('combines Gas Arrow and Toxic Growth to obliterate bosses'). Placed ground-cloud zone -> ground_targeted_circle. Two-stage place-then-detonate; secondary boss loop per 7.2. R-M6 (drift-tick cloud -> ground zone + note): the gas cloud is a standing DoT patch.
